items.description: CouponMoto provides coupon codes and exclusive offers to save you time and money while shopping online. The site covers a large number of stores. Coupons are updated and verified daily. The app is available on Google Play.
The Voucherify mashup allows to sell vouchers or coupons for through Shopify. Vouchers can be useful for exams, therapy sessions, and gift cards.
Tweets about the latest featured New York Times movie reviews.
Get random images from a Flickr group of your choosing. Good for use in other mashups, websites or just for browsing. Mashup using Google App Engine and Flickr.
This site was born with the idea of creating a virtual space where anybody can upload their photographic works in panoramic format and relate them to the place where they were taken.
Soccer Shots is a intro-to-soccer provider across the globe. Its messaging system uses the AT&T in-app messaging API.
Add your pets to your Facebook profile page.
Mobile Number Tracker traces the mobile numbers (of India only) with state, reference cities (exact or nearby city), service provider.
Golf course and syndicated golf news. Integrated Google Calendar lets you see upcoming events.

Scholarley is the unofficial Android client for viewing and managing Mendeley documents from an Android device. Mendeley users can open documents and attachments, and sort documents by artist, folder, group, author, and tags. Due to limitations on the Mendeley API, annotations are not supported in Scholarley.
This mashup plots the microfinance loans from Kiva lenders on a Google Map. Popups show details on the individual loans and borrowers.
Manage files in Amazon S3 storage. By providing a user interface to Amazon S3 accounts, files, and buckets, CloudBerry lets you manage your files on the cloud as you would on your local computer.
